_comment: Single source of truth for the Doodle Dash kit. make_pdf.py draws from 'sheet' and 'card'; process.py reads everything. Inches unless noted. Tune 'mat' and 'key' during the dry run.

mat._hue: OpenCV HSV (H 0-180). Green poster board ~35-85. For a blue mat try [90, 130].

camera._comment: Only used to estimate tilt. EXIF FocalLengthIn35mmFilm wins when present; phone main cameras are ~26 mm equivalent.

key._labDist: a*/b* distance from the mat median that still counts as mat
key._extra: matErodeIn: distance from any non-mat pixel for a pixel to count as 'clearly mat'. fieldSigmaIn: smoothing of the local mat-colour field (copes with uneven light). roiMarginIn: strip ignored along the mat edge.

piece._extra: edgeRingIn: outer ring of every piece never counted as ink (mat/paper blend). inkDarkL / inkChroma: Lab L drop / a*b* distance from the white-balanced paper that counts as ink. rectangularity: area / min-area-rect area for 'roughly rectangular' (deskew + box-line check). blob*: size of a second drawing that triggers 'pieces touching?'.

order._comment: Reading order: a piece joins the current row when its centroid is within max(rowBandMinIn, rowBandFrac x median piece height) below the row's first piece.

card._comment: Tray card layout, relative to the card's top-left corner. scaleTol: allowed marker-size error after rectification. keepRemainderIn2: a blob mostly under the card mask keeps its outside part if that part is at least this big (a piece touching the card).

greenPage._comment: Printed green scan page (make_pdf.py --green-pages). Inches from the top-left of the page. Four corner markers TL,TR,BR,BL use ids 'corners'. cutouts.py reads the same geometry.

sheet._boxes: x, y = top-left of the box, measured from the top-left of the page. Landscape: row 1 = tips + hero + 3 jump; row 2 = jump, ground, sky (one bonus jump box dropped: no room at these sizes)
